title: Laboratory
subtitle: Sample collection, result entry with critical-value alerts, and a clean order board

overview.lead: The Laboratory module runs the bench from order to result. Doctor-ordered tests arrive as Pending; the technician records specimen collection, enters parameter values against reference ranges, and the system flags abnormal and critical results — alerting the ordering doctor automatically. Ordered tests are also billed to the patient's visit, so the lab feeds the same cashier flow as everything else.
highlights: Order board across Pending, Collected and Performed states
Sample collection with specimen-type and collector traceability
Parameter result entry validated against reference ranges
Abnormal and critical values flagged and pushed to the doctor
Ordered tests auto-billed to the visit (lab → bill → cashier)
Demo: 19 orders — 6 pending, 7 collected, 6 performed (incl. 1 critical)

collection.title: Sample collection queue
collection.description: Every test a doctor has ordered lands in a Pending queue with the patient, test, category and urgency. The technician works straight down the list, so nothing waits unseen and urgent tests are visible at a glance.
bullets: All pending orders in one work queue
Patient, test, category and urgency on each row
Ordered directly from the doctor's workspace
collection.impact: The bench always knows exactly what is waiting and what is urgent.

collect.title: Collecting a sample
collect.description: Collecting a sample records the specimen type and the collector against the order, moving it from Pending to Collected. That traceability — who drew what, and when — is captured at the moment of collection, not reconstructed later.
collect.impact: Specimen traceability is built in, supporting accreditation and dispute resolution.

results.title: Result entry & critical alerts
results.description: The technician enters each parameter's value against its reference range. Out-of-range values are flagged abnormal, and critical values are escalated and pushed to the ordering doctor — so a dangerous result never sits silently in a queue.
bullets: Critical values escalated and alerted to the doctor
Results visible to the ordering doctor in their workspace
Verification gate before results are final
results.impact: Patient safety by design — critical results are surfaced, not buried.

orders.title: Lab order board
orders.description: A single board shows every order across its lifecycle — Pending, Collected and Performed — so the lab lead can see throughput, bottlenecks and outstanding work in one view.
bullets: Status at a glance for throughput and bottlenecks
orders.impact: The lab lead manages flow from one screen instead of chasing paper.

closing.lead: From order to result — safely and traceably
points: Critical values are flagged and pushed to the ordering doctor automatically.
Specimen collection captures chain-of-custody at the source.
Ordered tests are billed to the visit and settle through the cashier.
Every figure here is live from the running system on realistic demo data.
